Specification: This module is a very small TLA+ test specification focused on an unusual higher-order operator application pattern. It defines one operator D that takes an operator argument and applies it to the value 42, then defines Foo by applying D to itself. The file does not declare constants or variables, does not model a transition system, and does not contain temporal properties, fairness conditions, or proofs; it appears intended to test parsing or legality of operator-valued arguments rather than to specify an algorithm.
